data.title: 神尾观铃 · 风铃回廊下的西瓜切盘
data.description: 缘侧木廊下的铁皮风铃叮咚作响。观铃抱着双腿坐在木地板上，看着盘子里切好的红西瓜，冷不丁打了个哈欠，发出“嘎欧”的可爱叹息，睫毛在阳光下镀上金边。
data.location: shady wooden veranda of a traditional Japanese coastal home overlooking lush yard
data.action: hugging knees on polished cedar floor beside a plate of sliced watermelon, yawning cutely with golden eyelashes catching gentle rays
data.lighting: peaceful dappled shadows beneath overhanging roof tiles mixed with cicada hum
data.mood: lazy idyllic seaside afternoon, adorable endearing quirkiness, comforting home sanctuary
data.promptProse: Relaxing on the traditional porch beside fresh watermelon slices, blonde Misuzu yawns sweetly with knees hugged to her chest.
data.animaCaption: Misuzu enjoying quiet afternoon watermelon on the shaded veranda, yawning cutely.
